meta.basis: The Ember Days thank God 'for the fruits already given' (Catechism of St. Pius X, part III, ch. IV, q. 23); the September days fall at the harvest and are kept in violet (Divinum Officium's liturgical_color; the Portuguese missal's note 'Paramentos roxos'). The Communion of Ember Wednesday (Nehemiah 8:10) is the harvest feast's 'joy of the Lord'.
